notes.title: Breacher Story is out!
notes.content:
Greeting hackers, code cowboys and the geeks,

We are thrilled to annouce Breacher Story has been released on PC! We had an amazing time putting this story together and we hope you'll get a kick out of playing this unique game.

With its in-deep look at cybersecurity, social engineering and social commentary, we know Breacher Story stand in a class of its own when it comes to interactive stories. 

We truly hope you enjoy it.

Please support indie games and help us build up the hype!
